{{Quote|A jungle world&hellip; dome cities I see. Rodia it is.''"<br />"''A house in Kay-Tap square. Yes, I see it too.|Yoda and Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=RodiaKayTapSquare-CotF.flac|<ref name="Children of the Force" />}}
A '''mission''' occurred in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The infamous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] traveled to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] to find his next target, the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] child [[Wee Dunn/Legends|Wee Dunn]]. This mission was part two of a four part mission the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] assigned to Bane: capture four of the infants listed in the contents of the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]], a list of every force-sensitive infant in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] traced the bounty hunter's kidnappings of the children through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and so Kenobi volunteered to keep an eye on Wee Dunn and to protect the child.

The bounty hunter, disguised as a Jedi, failed to convince the child's mother, [[Mahtee Dunn/Legends|Mahtee Dunn]], that it was time for her son to begin his Jedi training that the Rodian [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] had promised her. When she refused to give him the child, Bane resorted to using a [[Hypnogazer/Legends|hypnogazer]], a weapon that alters the victim's mind, to force her to give into his demands. By the time Kenobi had arrived to protect the child, the bounty hunter was already on the run. After a brief chase, Bane escaped in his advanced [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], the [[Xanadu Blood/Legends|''Xanadu Blood'']].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I have delivered what you wanted; the Jedi were no problem. Anything else I can help you with?"''<br />''"I need test subjects. Four small children and bring them to Mustafar. I will take care of them."''<br />''"Kidnapping innocent children? Seems like a small-time crime for the likes of you."''<br />''"Among the children of the Jedi, there are no innocents."''<br />''"Sure, sure. As long as I get paid, it makes no difference to me.|Cad Bane and Sidious, discussing Bane's next mission.|audio=INeedTestSubjects-CotF.flac|<ref name="Children of the Force" />}}
[[File:AnakinOpensHolocron-CoD.png|thumb|left|250px|Bane forces coerces Skywalker into opening the stolen holocron]]
[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and the ''de facto'' leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], began to rely on the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] for his own personal use in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], tasking Bane with [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|stealing]] a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]<ref name="holo">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref> and the [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|capture]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]], keeper of the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]] on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. Considered to be the most efficient bounty hunter in the galaxy following, Bane accomplished both tasks, unlocking the information stored within: a list of every single Force-potent child in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="cargo">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref>

Bane was granted the advanced [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], the [[Xanadu Blood/Legends|''Xanadu Blood'']], as a token for his actions, and Darth Sidious gave him a new mission: capture four of the Force-sensitive infants listed in the Kyber crystal and deliver them to the remote mining planet of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], where Sidious planned to use them as test subjects in his experiments for the alteration of Force-sensitives to build his own personal corps of [[Spy/Legends|spies]].<ref name="Children of the Force" />

Bane's first target was [[Zinn Toa/Legends|Zinn Toa]], a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] who lived on the aquatic world of [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]]. In a group [[The Force/Legends|Force]] session, the Jedi [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Anakin Skywalker, and [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] detected his work on Glee Anselm through the force and decided to not send a Jedi peacekeeper to defend the child, since Bane most likely already accomplished his goal. Skywalker and his Padawan, Tano, were sent to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to protect the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] child [[Roo-Roo Page/Legends|Roo-Roo Page]], while Kenobi volunteered to go to Rodia, homeworld of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] race, to defend the child Wee Dunn,<ref name="guide" /> Bane's next target.<ref name="Children of the Force" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|Where is the bounty hunter?''"<br />"''Bounty hunter? He was a&hellip; Jedi&hellip;"<br />"''Jedi do not carry blasters.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Mahtee Dunn|audio=JediDoNotCarryBlasters-CotF.flac|<ref name="Children of the Force" />}}
[[File:SecondMissionToRodia-CotF.png|thumb|right|250px|Kenobi witnesses Bane kidnapping Wee Dunn]]
Bane traveled to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], where the bounty hunter, wearing a Jedi robe, spoke with the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Mahtee Dunn/Legends|Mahtee Dunn]], the mother of the Force-sensitive [[Wee Dunn/Legends|Wee Dunn]], in her home in the city [[Kay-Tap square/Legends|Kay-Tap square]]. Bane deceived Dunn, stating that Jedi impostors had been roaming the galaxy and stealing Force-sensitive children. Bane claimed that in order to keep her son safe, she would need to give her child up for the [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] that the fellow Rodian Jedi Bolla Ropal had promised her. When she refused, the Duros used a [[Hypnogazer/Legends|hypnogazer]],<ref name="guide" /> a device used to temporarily alter an individual's memory, to force her into complying with his demands.<ref name="Children of the Force" />

Leaving one of his twin blasters behind and preparing to depart with Wee Dunn, Bane witnessed Jedi Master Kenobi&mdash;who had been dispatched to prevent the kidnapping&mdash;enter the room. After Bane left the room, Kenobi was confronted by a confused Mahtee, who was pointing Bane's blaster at Kenobi. Kenobi made it clear that Bane was no Jedi, as Jedi don't carry blasters: the Jedi weapon of choice is usually a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. When Kenobi spotted Bane outside, Bane activated his boots, which were modified to hold rocket propulsors, and soared to the landing platform where the ''Xanadu Blood'' was parked. Kenobi pursued the bounty hunter, but arrived too late to prevent him from escaping with the Rodian infant.<ref name="Children of the Force" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I think the fear of whoever you work for&hellip; outweighs your fear of us.|Mace Windu to Cad Bane|audio=OutweighsYourFearOfUs-CotF.flac|<ref name="Children of the Force" />}}
Cad Bane was able to escape with the second out of the four children he needed to complete his mission, and brought Dunn to the Sith's secret stronghold on the volcanic mining planet, Mustafar, but was captured soon after. Dunn was later rescued by Anakin Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] on Mustafar.<ref name="Children of the Force" /><ref name="comment">{{SW|url=video/children-of-the-force-episode-featurette|text="Children of the Force" Episode Featurette}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Bane's capture of Wee Dunn was first depicted in "[[Children of the Force]]," aired on [[October 9]], [[2009]]. New technology introduced during production of [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|season two]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' made it possible to fit Rodia and several other planets depicted in "Children of the Force" into the time span of a single episode. Though the scenery and design of Rodia was already developed for the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|season one]] episode "[[Bombad Jedi]]," Rodia was redone for "Children of the Force" to make it look better.<ref name="comment" />
